Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the echo binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 140 account operation therefore ties up 7 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
